inputs.name: JSON
inputs.description: (optional) Layout JSON string used as the merge base.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.description: (required when nested) matches an entry in the parent's CellLabels grid.

inputs.name: Boundary
inputs.description: (root use only) a Rectangle3d (plane + width + height) -- e.g. a wall's border line extruded vertically. Its plane is copied straight into this document's 'plane' field; its width/height seed CellWidths/CellLengths as a single fixed-mm track EACH, but only when you haven't authored your own. No separate Plane input -- Boundary is the only way in.

inputs.name: CellWidths
inputs.description: Column track sizes (West-to-East): a positive number (mm), 'Nfr', or 'auto' (sized downstream by Geom from a nested child's content). 'minmax()' not yet resolved.

inputs.name: CellLengths
inputs.description: Row track sizes (North-to-South): same grammar as CellWidths.

inputs.name: CellLabels
inputs.description: Per-cell label grid: rows separated by newlines, cells by commas. Row 0 = North, column 0 = West.

inputs.name: ChildrenJSON
inputs.description: Child Layout JSON strings (this same component's JSON output), one per nested region, matched by Label.

inputs.name: BorderOverridesJSON
inputs.description: Border-override JSON strings (from pms-layout-border-override-v0), one per override on THIS node's own grid -- each selects a border via 'between' and carries an optional 'offset' (mm).

outputs.name: JSON
outputs.description: Layout JSON string for the merged (unsolved) node -- feeds a parent's ChildrenJSON, or the outermost instance's JSON feeds the Geom component's (list-access) JSON input. Carries a 'plane' field when Boundary was wired -- Geom reads that directly for this item's placement.
